text:
Alexander Zilberman Architecture P.C. (AZA) is a NYC based Architecture and Interior Design Firm. We are seeking an Intermediate Architectural Designer to join our team of skilled designers and architects.
The candidate will work on all phases of projects from Concept to Construction Administration. Responsible for project lead under the supervision of the Principal and will be the point person for our clients, engineers, government officials and any/all other persons involved with the project. We are looking for independent and resourceful teammate who enjoys to learn, grow and contribute to their environment.
Responsibilities:
- Lead all aspects of several projects/brands
- Participate during all phases of project delivery
- Interface with client, contractor, agencies, engineering and specialty consultants
- Lead the coordination and document preparation for projects and provide quality assurance via review of project documentation
- Other related duties
Qualifications: 
This is a Full-Time in-office position. We offer Health Benefits, 401(K), Profit Sharing, paid Commuter Benefits, Vacation/Holidays/Sick Leave.
Please send the following to [email protected]:
Resume, portfolio and electrical samples of work.
